verdict.rationale: Unity's first-party AI Assistant package is documented for creating assets, automating workflows, analyzing performance, and performing project actions through natural-language prompts. Messages to the Assistant are metered via Unity Credits. Agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can also drive the Editor through Unity's official MCP server, now offered as the CLI's `unity mcp` mode. missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, the AI tooling is beta/pre-release (2.20.0-pre.1) with the in-editor MCP deprecated, and there is little detail on which Editor operations natural-language commands can actually cover.
